# Richmond Journal of Law and Technology

> > The first exclusively online law review dedicated to scholarship at the intersection of law and technology.

JOLT is published by the University of Richmond School of Law and features peer-reviewed articles, blog posts, podcasts, and symposia covering emerging legal issues in technology, cryptocurrency, digital rights, and internet law. The journal serves as a premier venue for legal scholarship on topics including blockchain regulation, platform governance, and Section 230 reform.

## Key Topics

- Law and Technology
- Cryptocurrency Regulation
- Blockchain
- Section 230
- Digital Rights
- Internet Law
- Securities Law
- Platform Governance
- Content Moderation
- Intellectual Property
- Patent Law
- Online Publication
- Legal Scholarship
- Technology Law
- Digital Regulation

## Current Issues & Publications

- [Volume XXXII, Issue 1, Fall 2025](https://jolt.richmond.edu/volume-xxxii-issue-1-fall-2025): Current journal issue featuring law and technology articles on cryptocurrency and digital rights.
- [About JOLT](https://jolt.richmond.edu/about-2): About page describing JOLT as online law review published by University of Richmond School of Law.
- [Homepage](https://jolt.richmond.edu): Homepage for Richmond Journal of Law and Technology, the first exclusively online law review.

## Articles & Blog

- [Blog](https://jolt.richmond.edu/blog): Blog posts covering legal analysis on trademarks, intellectual property, and technology law.
- [Contributing to the JOLT Blog](https://jolt.richmond.edu/interested-in-contributing-to-the-jolt-blog): Guidelines for submitting blog contributions to JOLT with Bluebook citation standards.

## Events & Symposia

- [Symposium 2026](https://jolt.richmond.edu/symposium2026): 2026 symposium on platform governance, content moderation, and digital regulation.
- [Podcasts](https://jolt.richmond.edu/podcasts): Podcast series discussing law and technology topics including patent law and cryptocurrency.
